answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x and confined to the primary region during peak settlement. Circuit breaking would drop customer writes; read-replica routing does not serve writes. Adding capacity in a sick primary may be too slow and may not fix a regional fault. Rollback is plausible given the 2h-old release but fails if the cause is regional infra and still risks in-flight settlement. Failover matches the regional confinement and memory_b2 (clean shift, latency recovered in minutes) while continuing to accept writes. Verifying b2 for write-safety under load. Broad, one-shot shift because a partial test would consume the only intervention without restoring availability. Uncertain whether a globally shipped bad release would follow traffic to the secondary.
